description: The OECD's projections for the next two years from its Economic Outlook, for 50+ economies, the euro area, the OECD and the world: GDP growth, inflation (harmonised for the euro area), core inflation, unemployment, budget balance, government debt, current account and short- and long-term interest rates, beside its estimates for the two years before.

countries.description: Countries or groups: names ("Germany", "euro area", "world", "OECD") or ISO codes (US, JPN).

measures.description: What to project: "gdp growth", "inflation", "core inflation", "unemployment", "budget balance", "government debt", "current account", "short term interest rate", "long term interest rate". Default: GDP growth, inflation, unemployment.

name: economic_outlook

outputSchema.description: rows are area and measure pairs with a value per year in the order of columns; the last two years are projections.

title: Economic outlook (OECD projections)
